hebrewText: וְ/אַף אָמְנָ֥ם שָׁגִ֑יתִי אִ֝תִּ֗/י תָּלִ֥ין מְשׁוּגָתִֽ/י

tokens.bdb: meaning accession (used as an adverb or conjunction); also or yea; adversatively though
tokens.kjv: also, [phrase] although, and (furthermore, yet), but, even, [phrase] how much less (more, rather than), moreover, with, yea.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: meaning accession ; also or yea; adversatively though
tokens.enLiteralWord: meaning accession ; also or yea; adversatively though
tokens.explanation: meaning accession ; also or yea; adversatively though
tokens.explanationEn: meaning accession ; also or yea; adversatively though

tokens.kjv: indeed, no doubt, surely, (it is, of a) true(-ly, -th).

tokens.bdb: to stray (causatively, mislead), usually (figuratively) to mistake, especially (morally) to transgress; by extension (through the idea of intoxication) to reel, (figuratively) be enraptured
tokens.kjv: (cause to) go astray, deceive, err, be ravished, sin through ignorance, (let, make to) wander.

tokens.bdb: properly, nearness (used only as a preposition or an adverb), near; hence, generally, with, by, at, among, etc.
tokens.kjv: against, among, before, by, for, from, in(-to), (out) of, with. Often with another prepositional prefix.

tokens.bdb: to stop (usually over night); by implication, to stay permanently; hence (in a bad sense) to be obstinate (especially in words, to complain)
tokens.kjv: abide (all night), continue, dwell, endure, grudge, be left, lie all night, (cause to) lodge (all night, in, -ing, this night), (make to) murmur, remain, tarry (all night, that night).
